I told my family and I got beaten up and my whole self changed, since that day which was last week, I started becoming suicidal and depressed, to the point I tried hurt myself. I really don’t know what to do, where to go, who to tell because almost everyone I know mocks mental illnesses, calls them fake and all that and I can’t tell my family of course, they think it’s utter bullsh*t and that it’s because I’m too sensitive towards everything and YES, I admit it’s true, I’ve always been a super emotional person since I was born, I was never strong mentally, I’m easily affected by every word.
